egress.terms: Not metered, but 1 GB/mo of attachments caps the whole play.

tooling: Observable notebooks/FileAttachment API; attachments are content-addressed and fetchable from notebook pages.
chaining: 1 GB/mo per account, no rollover. Not viable.
limits_note: 1 GB/mo attachments on Free and Pro alike; embed watermark on Free.
reliability_note: Attachments persist (unlike a notebook disk) but the monthly 1 GB ceiling makes this a rounding error.

evidence.proved: comparison table: 'File attachments | 1 GB / mo.' on both Free and Pro (read via firecrawl after a 429 from the default provider)
the Free plan includes 1 GB per month of file attachments
evidence.quote: File attachments | 1 GB / mo. | 1 GB / mo.
